parameters.name: GroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the application group. You can find this ID on the **Application Management** page in the console.

parameters.name: JobIdList
parameters.description: The IDs of the jobs to disable.

parameters.name: Namespace
parameters.description: The ID of the namespace that contains the jobs. You can find this ID on the **Namespaces** page in the console.

parameters.name: NamespaceSource
parameters.description: This parameter is used only by specific third-party services.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the region where the jobs are located.
